responses.fb_other: I felt like some of the peaks were so small they were nearly unrecognizable.  I also wasn't 100% sure the the peaks I created were being properly saved because they weren't numbered when I was finished creating them.  ALSO, it would have been a lot faster with some keyboard shortcuts.  Being able to delete some of the peaks with a quick swipe of the 'delete' button would be super helpful.  Setting the initial point when creating a peak was a bit irritation as well.  Finally (I think), not knowing exactly how many of the annotations to do was frustrating.  Participants on Prolific are always getting tasks rejected for not completing enough annotations, or not writing enough words, or SOMETHING similar that is left a bit too ambiguous.
